passage:
Room 706 started a clean desk contest. Every Friday, the teacher checked each desk. Students with clean desks got a star.
At first, everyone worked hard. Desks were empty, books were straight, and pencils were in boxes. But after two weeks, some students lost interest.
One student, Peter, had a different idea. He put a small paper sign inside his desk: "Future Peter will thank you." Every time he wanted to throw papers inside, he saw the sign and cleaned up.
His desk stayed neat for the whole month. When his classmates asked how he did it, he showed them the sign.
Soon, many desks had small messages inside. The contest became less about stars and more about helping tomorrow's self.
